# Gcore DDoS protection

> Open Gcore DDoS Protection docs for protection modes, service setup, and attack event logs.

- [DDoS protection](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection.md): Open Gcore DDoS Protection docs for protection modes, service setup, and attack event logs.
- [About DDoS Protection](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/about-ddos-protection.md): Configure Gcore DDoS Protection by choosing Basic (free) or Advanced (paid, always-on TMS) protection based on attack frequency and server criticality.

## Setting up the service
- [Service activation](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/service-activation.md): Set up Gcore DDoS Protection through self-service plan activation, network submission, NOC review, and configuration steps.
- [Plan activation](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/plan-activation.md): Activate a Gcore DDoS Protection plan by selecting a tariff and entering payment details in the Customer Portal, with a 7-day free trial included.
- [Network submission](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/network-submission.md): Submit a network for Gcore DDoS Protection with CIDR notation, AS number, and a Letter of Authorization PDF for NOC review.
- [Review and approval](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/review-and-approval.md): Track NOC review of a submitted network through approval, rejection, and email notification outcomes.
- [Network configuration](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/network-configuration.md): Configure a GRE endpoint and protection profile for an approved DDoS Protection network in the Customer Portal.
- [Configure a custom protection profile](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/custom-protection-profile-configuration.md): Configure custom DDoS protection profiles with rules and policies, including protocol-aware options for gaming traffic.
- [Apply a custom profile to a protected network](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/apply-a-custom-profile-to-a-protected-network.md): Assign a custom protection profile to a protected network by editing the network in the Customer Portal.
- [Set a GRE tunnel with Gcore](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/gre-tunneling/set-a-gre-tunnel-with-gcore.md): Configure a GRE tunnel with Gcore on Cisco routers or Ubuntu Linux, and a BGP peering session on Cisco, for DDoS Protection.
- [Troubleshooting](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/onboarding-service/troubleshooting.md): Resolve DDoS Protection setup, notification, null-routing, and profile issues, and find what to send support for network, Kentik, and ACL requests.
- [DDoS log and monitoring](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/events-log.md): View DDoS Protection events log and attack email notifications in the Customer Portal, including attack volume, targeted IPs, and incident details.
- [API Access](https://docs.gcore.com/ddos-protection/api-access.md): Authenticate to the DDoS Protection REST API, list and retrieve event logs, and open the API reference.
